 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Game date, time and location: Wednesday, Oct. 21, 7:10 p.m. ET, Kia Center, Orlando, Florida
 TV: MagicTV 27 (Orlando), WANF/Gray Media, Prime (Atlanta)
 Radio: 96.9 The Game (Orlando), 92.9 The Game (Atlanta)
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement VITALS : These teams finished just one game apart in the Southeast last season as the division race wasn't decided until the final week. Atlanta winning ended up landing the No. 6 seed while Orlando finished eighth, surviving the play-in stage before ultimately blowing a first-round series lead vs. Detroit. Franz Wagner, whose status was deemed questionable when the week began due to shoulder soreness, vowed to play and looks on track to debut as he looks to turn the page following an injury-riddled 2025-26.
 There weren't many changes made on either side in the offseason outside of Orlando parting ways with head coach Jamahl Mosley and hiring Spurs assistant Sean Sweeney. Personnel-wise, the Hawks didn't sign Jonathan Kuminga but did pick up defensive standout Luguentz Dort from the Thunder.
 Orlando had some tough injury luck in the preseason due to sixth man Anthony Black missing this opener with an ankle sprain and reserve forward Jonathan Isaac and Noah Penda being ruled out. The Hawks are the healtheir group for fifth-year head coach Quin Snyder, who now has 504 career regular-season wins after leading the Hawks to a division title and their first playoff appearance since his opening season after arriving from Utah, where he coached from 2014-22.
 The Hawks lead the Magic 78-65 in the regular season all-time, winning 18 of the last 23. Atlanta swept the series 4-0 last season and have a five-game win streak as a result. Orlando's last win came at home on April 8, 2025 (119-112), but lost 130-101 when these teams last met at Kia Center on April 1.
